Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to properly extract credible and authoritative information regarding the father of Thomas Stafford, 3rd Earl of Stafford. While the agent identified Hugh Stafford, 2nd Earl of Stafford, as the father based on Wikipedia, it overlooked contradicting information present in another source mentioned on the same page, stating Ralph de Stafford, 1st Earl of Stafford, as the father. This demonstrates an error in both selection and evaluation of sources, as no attempt was made to triangulate the information or flag the discrepancy between sources. Consequently, this caused the propagation of an incorrect answer without proper verification.
